summary: Tuesday: VIX sub-20 (19.12), SPX +1.18%, NDX +1.96% on Monday close. Bank earnings on deck Tuesday AM: JPM, WFC, BLK, JNJ. Hormuz blockade de-escalation priced in, oil retreating toward $92. Good Friday holiday-shortened week. TSMC Thursday. Crypto: BTC $75K test post breakout. China Q1 GDP Wed.

risks.label: Bank Earnings Sector Risk — JPM/WFC/BLK
risks.detail: If JPM/WFC confirm the GS FICC weakness, XLF breaks down. NII guidance and credit loss provisions are the key tells. JPM EPS est $5.45, WFC $1.57, BLK $12.09.

risks.label: Oil Reversal Risk — De-escalation Priced
risks.detail: WTI retreated to $92 from $100+ on Iran-backchannel talk. If diplomacy fails, oil spike back to $100+ kills the risk-on reboot. XLE overextended.

risks.label: Trump-Xi Summit Tariff Risk
risks.detail: Section 301 comments due today (Apr 15). Trump 50% China tariff threat still in play despite soft rhetoric. Summit May 14-15 remains fragile.

risks.label: IMF Global Growth Downgrade
risks.detail: IMF cut 2026 world GDP forecast to 2.8% (from 3.2%) citing tariff uncertainty. US revised to 1.8%. Stagflation tail still live.

risks.label: Good Friday Liquidity Squeeze
risks.detail: Markets closed Apr 18. Positioning pressure compressed Mon-Thu. Expect higher intraday volatility late-week.

events.label: JPM, WFC, BLK, JNJ Earnings (Tue AM)
events.detail: Most concentrated financial reporting day. JPM EPS est $5.45, WFC $1.57, BLK $12.09. Sector tone-setter after GS miss.

events.label: China Q1 GDP (Wed Apr 16)
events.detail: Consensus +4.8% YoY. Miss <4.5% = PBOC easing. Beat >5.0% = validates Beijing stimulus. FXI reaction key.

events.label: TSMC Q1 Earnings (Thu Apr 17)
events.detail: Revenue +35% YoY confirmed. AI chip super-cycle validation. Guidance and Arizona/Japan fab commentary key for SMH and NVDA.

events.label: Retail Sales March (Wed)
events.detail: Consensus +0.4% MoM. Measures consumer resilience against tariff pass-through.

events.label: Good Friday Closure (Fri Apr 18)
events.detail: US equity and bond markets closed. Compressed trading week. Positioning ahead of long weekend = higher vol.

events.label: Section 301 Tariff Comments Due
events.detail: Public comment deadline today for proposed 50% China tariff. Watch for corporate lobbying signals.

opportunities.label: XLF — Post-JPM Continuation
opportunities.detail: Financials benefit from yield curve steepening. If JPM beats and NII guidance raised, XLF breaks above $52. Entry $50.80-51.20, Stop $49.60, TP1 $53, TP2 $55. R:R 1:2.

opportunities.label: CRDO — AI Networking Momentum
opportunities.detail: Credo Technology broke out post-scanner A+ signal. AI infrastructure chain play, lightly held. Entry $54-55, Stop $50, TP1 $62, TP2 $70.

opportunities.label: BTC — $75K Test in Progress
opportunities.detail: BTC consolidating $73.8K-74.5K. Clean break of $75K opens $80K. Daily close required. Capital rotation out of gold.

opportunities.label: AAPL — Piper Sandler PT Raise $320
opportunities.detail: Two fresh PT raises (Piper $320, Wedbush $310). iPhone 17 Pro cycle catalyst. Reclaimed $210 post-tariff selloff. Entry $208-212.

opportunities.label: SMH — TSMC Pre-Earnings Trade
opportunities.detail: Semis firmed Monday, NDX +1.96%. TSMC Thursday = sector catalyst. Decoupled from Iran noise. Entry $295-298.

opportunities.label: DAX — German Fiscal Stimulus Flow
opportunities.detail: DAX +0.85% Monday, EU aid bill to Ukraine passed. Infrastructure and defense (Rheinmetall, Siemens) leading. EWG entry candidate.

regime.label: VIX Sub-20 Confirmed (19.12)
regime.detail: VIX closed below 20 for first time in 3 weeks. Options complacency returning. Scanner score 0.46 neutral-risk-on.

regime.label: Dow Positive YTD 2026
regime.detail: DJIA reclaimed +0.4% YTD after tariff selloff. Market breadth improving — advancers 3:1.

regime.label: Risk-On Rotation Back to Tech/Semis
regime.detail: NDX +1.96% on Monday — leadership returning. XLK outperforming defensives. Breadth confirmation.

regime.label: Gold Stalling Near ATH
regime.detail: Gold $4,760 retreating from $4,802 ATH as safe-haven bid fades. Rotation signal into risk assets.

regime.label: Crypto Fear Softening
regime.detail: Fear & Greed climbed from 8 to 18. 49-day extreme fear streak broken. Sentiment shifting.
